record.edic_text:
1709 empneo {emp-neh'-o}

from 1722 and 4154; TDNT - 6:452,876; v

AV - breathe out 1; 1

1) to breathe in or on
2) to inhale
   2a) threatenings and slaughter were so to speak the element from
       which he drew his breath

same.cexp: （神的）靈；內心；心思意念；靈；生命；呼吸
靈的；屬靈的人；屬靈的事；超自然的
屬靈地，受到聖靈的引導；象徵性地
